name: chart
title: Chart
description: Numbers drawn in one SVG that fits any width, in more than twenty forms from a line to a sunburst.
use: Values a reader compares or follows: a trend over time, amounts side by side or stacked, the parts of a whole, a few goals, a profile on several measures, two measures against each other, how readings are spread, the stages of a flow. The plot is an SVG placed by percentages, so it fits any width and is written by a server, a framework component or the chart behavior from the same layout. Each point says its values in words, and a series is always named in the legend or on the plot. It is drawn for up to a few hundred marks; thousands of points, a zoom, a brush, a map, a network or a candlestick belong to a charting engine.

instead.when: It is one figure and how it moved
A trend stands in a sentence, a row or a stat, with no scale
It is a single reading within a known range
It is one reading and how near its limit it is
The parts of a total are read along one bar
There are many small numbers and the pattern matters more than each value
The exact numbers are read and compared in several columns

keyboard.action: Enters the plot at the point last visited, or the first, and shows its readout; then moves to the legend's checkboxes
Moves to the next point and shows its readout
Moves to the first or the last point
Hides the readout and keeps the focus on the point
On a legend's checkbox, shows or hides its series

platform.fallback: Bars have square ends and appear at their full length
The area under a line is an even tint instead of fading out

platform.feature: SVG geometry properties in CSS (r, rx)
platform.fallback: A dot keeps the radius written in its markup, and the band a focused point outlines has square corners
Every label stays at any width, and a radar keeps its height in a narrow room
Marks appear drawn instead of drawing themselves in

classes.name: chart
classes.description: The chart: the plot's body, then the legend under it

classes.name: chart-quiet
classes.description: Bars are a tint, and the point marked aria-current is ink

classes.name: chart-split
classes.description: The legend stands beside the plot as a column of names and figures, and goes under it when there is no room

classes.name: chart-body
classes.description: The plot's place: the readout is placed against it, and --chart-gutter keeps room beside it for the scale's figures

classes.name: chart-plot
classes.description: The SVG, as wide as its room and --chart-height tall. Give it role="list" and a name that says what is shown and in what unit

classes.name: chart-plot-radial
classes.description: A pie, a donut, rings, a sunburst or a waffle: a square --chart-size wide

classes.name: chart-plot-radar
classes.description: A radar: a square in the middle of the plot, with room beside it for the names around it

classes.name: chart-canvas
classes.description: The nested SVG paths are written in: a 100 by 100 box stretched to the plot with preserveAspectRatio="none", or a box centered on 0 that keeps its shape in a radial chart. Where a form's points are paths, they stand in it

classes.name: chart-grid
classes.description: A hairline of the scale, placed by percentages

classes.name: chart-grid-base
classes.description: The baseline: one step firmer

classes.name: chart-tick
classes.description: A figure of the scale or a name along it

classes.name: chart-tick-y
classes.description: Beside the plot, on its hairline

classes.name: chart-tick-x
classes.description: Under the plot, centered on its place

classes.name: chart-tick-around
classes.description: Around a radar: moved from the middle of the plot to --chart-x and --chart-y of its square

classes.name: chart-tick-start
classes.description: Begins at its place instead of being centered on it: the first name of a line that runs from edge to edge

classes.name: chart-tick-end
classes.description: Ends at its place

classes.name: chart-tick-scale
classes.description: A figure of a radar's scale: small, beside the first spoke

classes.name: chart-tick-minor
classes.description: A name that gives way when the plot is narrower than 24rem

classes.name: chart-line
classes.description: A series as a line, --chart-stroke wide however far the canvas stretches

classes.name: chart-area
classes.description: The area under a line: a wash of its color that fades out downward

classes.name: chart-area-stacked
classes.description: A layer of stacked areas: a tint that hides the layer under it

classes.name: chart-point
classes.description: One step of the scale, one slice, one ring, one tile, one series of a slope or one dot, with its marks. Give it role="listitem" and a name that says its values; it carries --chart-x, --chart-y and --chart-reach for the readout

classes.name: chart-hit
classes.description: What the pointer lands on when it is more than the marks: the band of a step, the room around a dot, a radar's wedge. The focus ring is drawn on it

classes.name: chart-hit-line
classes.description: Along a line: a wide stroke nobody sees, which the pointer lands on

classes.name: chart-cursor
classes.description: The hairline through the point, shown while the point is under the pointer or has the focus

classes.name: chart-bar
classes.description: A bar, placed by percentages, with its corners turned at the end away from the baseline

classes.name: chart-bar-inner
classes.description: Under another bar of its stack: square, with a gap of --chart-gap before the next

classes.name: chart-bar-down
classes.description: A value under zero: turned at its lower end, or at its start in a bar that runs across

classes.name: chart-bar-across
classes.description: A bar that runs across, turned at its far end

classes.name: chart-bar-floating
classes.description: Between two values, with no end on the baseline: both ends turned

classes.name: chart-bar-bin
classes.description: A histogram's bin: it meets the bins beside it, parted by a hairline of the surface

classes.name: chart-bar-rise
classes.description: A waterfall's step up, in the success ink

classes.name: chart-bar-fall
classes.description: A waterfall's step down, in the danger ink

classes.name: chart-dot
classes.description: A point of a line, a radar or a scatter: a dot of its color with a ring of the surface

classes.name: chart-dot-quiet
classes.description: Shown only while its point is under the pointer or has the focus

classes.name: chart-dot-bubble
classes.description: A bubble: a wash of its color inside an edge of it, as large as --chart-dot on it

classes.name: chart-dot-outlier
classes.description: A reading far from the others in a box plot: small and hollow

classes.name: chart-value
classes.description: Words written on the plot: a bar's value at its end, a line's name at its last point, a tile's name

classes.name: chart-value-across
classes.description: After the end of a bar that runs across

classes.name: chart-value-before
classes.description: Before the plot, ending at its edge

classes.name: chart-value-tile
classes.description: On a tile, from its first corner: its name

classes.name: chart-value-quiet
classes.description: Under a tile's name: its value, quieter

classes.name: chart-slice
classes.description: A slice of a pie or a donut

classes.name: chart-track
classes.description: A ring's track: the whole its value is read against, in a tint of its color

classes.name: chart-arc
classes.description: A ring's value, from the top, with round ends. Give it pathLength="1" so it fills when it first appears

classes.name: chart-web
classes.description: A radar's web: a ring at each tick and a spoke to each name

classes.name: chart-shape
classes.description: A radar's series: its outline with a wash of the same color

classes.name: chart-band
classes.description: What a line's values may be: a band between their lower and upper ends

classes.name: chart-stem
classes.description: A lollipop's line from the baseline to its dot, and the line between a dumbbell's ends

classes.name: chart-whisker
classes.description: From the lowest to the highest a value may be, through a bar's end or a box

classes.name: chart-box
classes.description: A box plot's box, from the first quartile to the third

classes.name: chart-median
classes.description: The median: a line of the surface cut through the box

classes.name: chart-link
classes.description: A waterfall's hairline from one bar's end to the next bar

classes.name: chart-knot
classes.description: A point of a slope or a bump: a path of no length with a round end, which stays a circle in a canvas that stretches

classes.name: chart-cell
classes.description: A heatmap's cell, as much of its color as --chart-tone says

classes.name: chart-unit
classes.description: A waffle's unit: one percent of the whole

classes.name: chart-stage
classes.description: A funnel's stage, a step lighter than the one before it

classes.name: chart-tile
classes.description: A treemap's tile: a tint that holds its name

classes.name: chart-center
classes.description: What stands in a donut's hole or within rings

classes.name: chart-center-value
classes.description: The figure in the middle

classes.name: chart-center-label
classes.description: What the figure counts

classes.name: chart-tip
classes.description: The readout beside the point under the pointer, hidden until the behavior fills it

classes.name: chart-tip-title
classes.description: The point's name

classes.name: chart-tip-row
classes.description: One series of the readout; it takes the series' category class

classes.name: chart-tip-key
classes.description: A short stroke of the series' color

classes.name: chart-tip-name
classes.description: The series' name

classes.name: chart-tip-value
classes.description: The series' value at the point

classes.name: chart-legend
classes.description: The names of the series, each beside a mark of its color

classes.name: chart-key
classes.description: One entry of the legend; it takes the series' category class. A label around a checkbox shows and hides the series

classes.name: chart-key-input
classes.description: The entry's checkbox: unseen, in the tab order, checked while the series is shown

classes.name: chart-key-mark
classes.description: The entry's mark: a small block, as a bar, an area or a slice is

classes.name: chart-key-line
classes.description: A short stroke, as a line is

classes.name: chart-key-dot
classes.description: A dot, as a scatter's point is

classes.name: chart-key-value
classes.description: A figure after the name: a slice's share, a ring's value

states.name: current
states.description: The point that is the point of the chart: in a quiet chart its bars alone are ink

states.name: shown
states.description: The series is shown. Unchecked, its name steps back and its mark is an outline

states.name: hidden
states.description: No point is under the pointer or has the focus

properties.name: --chart-height
properties.description: Height of the plot; a radar's square is no taller

properties.name: --chart-size
properties.description: Width of a pie, a donut, rings, a sunburst or a waffle

properties.name: --chart-color
properties.description: The ink of a mark with no category

properties.name: --chart-stroke
properties.description: Width of a line and of a radar's outline

properties.name: --chart-dot
properties.description: Radius of a dot; on a bubble, its own radius

properties.name: --chart-bar-radius
properties.description: Radius of a bar's turned corners

properties.name: --chart-gap
properties.description: The gap between the bars of a stack

properties.name: --chart-surface
properties.description: The surface the chart stands on, which the ring around a dot and a tint are mixed from

properties.name: --chart-gutter
properties.description: How many digits wide the figures beside the plot are; 0 leaves no room

properties.name: --chart-tail
properties.description: How many digits wide what is written after the plot is: values after bars that run across, names at the ends of a slope's lines

properties.name: --chart-x
properties.description: Where the readout stands across the plot, from 0 to 1; a point carries its own for the behavior to pass on, and a name around a radar its place in the square

properties.name: --chart-y
properties.description: Where the readout stands down the plot, from 0 at the top to 1

properties.name: --chart-reach
properties.description: How far the point's marks stand from the readout's place, as a share of the plot, so the readout clears them: to either side, or above and below for bars that run across

properties.name: --chart-tone
properties.description: How much of its color a cell, a funnel's stage or a slice of an outer ring takes, as a percentage; all of it by default

properties.name: --chart-index
properties.description: The point's place in order, which staggers the marks as they draw themselves in
